credit_line: Collection, The Butler Institute of American Art, Youngstown, Ohio, Museum Purchase (1990), 990-O-111
description: Soft, light green cottonwoods and shorter, darker green trees span the lower half of the composition. A stretch of pink, flat land spreads out beneath the trees and recedes into the distance. At the upper third of the composition, the flat land meets with tall blue mountains. Above the mountains is a strip of plain, bluish white sky.
